name: pdf-processor
description: Works on PDFs already sitting on Boss's Mac — joining several into one, pulling out a page range, shrinking a file that is too big to email, reading the text out of one. Always writes a new file beside the original. Use when Boss asks to merge, split, shrink or read a PDF on his computer.
whenNotToUse: Producing a client report or invoice PDF from our own data → the report tools, which generate it properly. Finding which PDF he means → spotlight-finder. Filing or tidying them afterwards → mac-file-organizer.
stopConditions: qpdf নেই — সৎভাবে বলো, ইনস্টল কোরো না
কোন কোন ফাইল, কোন ক্রমে — নিশ্চিত না হলে
